content_sections.heading: AMSCL Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 859763 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download AMSCL notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Bachelor Degree in Instrumentation/Bio-Medical Engineering/Medical Electronics or Masters Degree in Instrumentation/Bio-Medical Engineering/Medical Electronics from Govt. recognized Institution/University; Diploma in Instrumentation/Bio-Medical Engineering/Medical Electronics from Govt. recognized Institution/University Experience: Degree holders: minimum 3 years in procurement of medical equipment in Govt. organization/Semi Govt. Organization/Private Health Institution; Diploma holders: minimum 5 years in the same Age limit: Maximum 45 years (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC/MOBC 3 years, PwD 10 years Other conditions: High proficiency in written and oral English Computer proficiency in MS Office (word, excel, power point) Desirable: Experience in procurement through GeM and e-Tender

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for AMSCL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates without the above qualification need not apply

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Engagement on contractual basis, in mission mode The number of vacancies may vary at the time of recruitment

content_sections.heading: How Will AMSCL Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Interview / selection test, schedule to be published on the website along with the list of provisionally shortlisted candidates Schedule of interview / selection test will be published on https://amscl.assam.gov.in in due course along with the list of provisionally shortlisted candidates No separate individual call letter will be sent for interview / selection test

content_sections.heading: AMSCL Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview/ selection test.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AMSCL Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online on the AMSCL, Assam website https://amscl.assam.gov.in. Online applications are received till 26.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The undersigned reserves the right to reject any or all applications without assigning any reasons Applicants are advised to visit the website for updates

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AMSCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AMSCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies for Executive (Procurement-BME).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AMSCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC/MOBC 3 years, PwD 10 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 42,350 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor Degree or Masters Degree in Instrumentation/Bio-Medical Engineering/Medical Electronics with minimum 3 years of experience in procurement of medical equipment; OR Diploma in the same fields with minimum 5 years of such experience.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. High proficiency in written and oral English. Computer proficiency in MS Office (word, excel, power point).

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates without the above qualification need not apply.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview / selection test, schedule to be published on the website along with the list of provisionally shortlisted candidates. Schedule of interview / selection test will be published on https://amscl.assam.gov.in in due course along with the list of provisionally shortlisted candidates. No separate individual call letter will be sent for interview / selection test.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement on contractual basis, in mission mode. The number of vacancies may vary at the time of recruitment.
